name: Line Mask Reveal Headline
composition: Large display headline text sliding upward out of an invisible overflow-hidden line clip box.
focal_point: Text baseline entering smoothly line by line.
layout_behavior: Block display container with `overflow-hidden` line wrapper spans.
typography_characteristics: Bold display variable font (36px - 64px) with tight tracking (-0.03em).
choreography: Line 1 slides up `translateY(100%)` -> `translateY(0)` (0ms delay). Line 2 slides up (80ms delay). Line 3 slides up (160ms delay).
perceived_physics: Smooth print press impression rising onto paper surface.
interaction_model: Triggers automatically on viewport entry or initial page load.
visual_hierarchy: Primary visual anchor of the page header.
why_it_works: Prevents layout jumps while creating an elegant editorial entrance.
accessibility: Screen readers read complete un-split text string seamlessly.
responsive: Line wrappers reflow fluidly using CSS inline-block spans.
web_implementation_strategy: CSS keyframe transition or Framer Motion variants.
portfolio_applications: Main headline entrance for developer portfolio home or project title.
notes: Extracted from Jitter website and headline animation templates.

name: Animated Metric Counter Up Roll
composition: Large numerical metric (e.g. '99.8%', '<12ms') rolling rapidly up from 0 to final value.
focal_point: Individual digits spinning vertically inside number column slots.
layout_behavior: Inline flex container with fixed digit column widths to prevent width jitter.
typography_characteristics: Bold tabular figures monospace font (`font-mono` / `tabular-nums`) at 48px - 72px.
choreography: Digits roll upward in parallel with slight stagger across decimal places.
perceived_physics: Precision digital odometer or stopwatch rolling to target value.
interaction_model: Triggers when metric card scrolls into view.
visual_hierarchy: Dominant visual element inside metric / KPI cards.
why_it_works: Number motion creates an authoritative feeling of real-time measurement and precision.
accessibility: Always include `aria-label="99.8%"` on outer container so screen readers announce full value instantly.
responsive: Uses `tabular-nums` class to ensure zero layout shift during rolling.
performance: Smooth JS requestAnimationFrame or CSS transform stream.
web_implementation_strategy: Framer Motion `useSpring` and `useTransform` on animated value.
portfolio_applications: Showcasing Lighthouse score ('100/100'), test coverage ('98.5%'), or latency reduction ('-65ms').
notes: Extracted from Jitter 'The Track' countdown and numerical metric templates.
